paite: "Zion tang a nuam lua a omte leh Samaria tang a bittak a omte leh Israel nam lian lak a inkuan mithupite tung agik hi!
heading: Israel Hihsiatna
english: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!

paite: Kalneh ah hoh unla, en un; huai a kipan in Hamath kho thupi ah hoh un; Philistia gam Gath ah paisuk unla; hiai gamte sang in noute na hoihzaw uhia? Nou gam sang in agam uh azazaw a hia?
english: Go to Calneh, and see. From there go to Hamath the great. Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are they better than these kingdoms? Is their border greater than your border?

paite: Nou ni hoih lou gamlapi a koih leh hiamgam tunna naihsakte aw,
english: Alas for you who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near,

paite: saiha lupna a lum a, atutphah sau tungte ua kizia a, belamhon lak a belamnoute leh bawnghonte lak a kipan bawngtuaite ne a;
english: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall,

paite: David bang a kaihging tumtum a, lasak ding na bawlbawl uh;
english: who strum on the strings of a harp, who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;

paite: belhbu lian a uain dawn a, sathau hoihpen a kinuhte mah; himahleh Joseph haksatna ziak in alungkham kei uhi.
english: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

paite: Huchi in tua sal dia pai masate toh sal in apai ding ua, nuam sa a kiziate nopsakna lakmang in a-om ding hi."
english: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive. The feasting and lounging will end.

paite: TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Toupa PATHIAN in amah-le-amah kilou in akichiam a, "Jakob kisaktheihna ka kih a, akumpipa' inn te ka mudah a; huaiziak in khua leh asung a om tengteng ka mansak sin ahi.”
english: “The Lord Yahweh has sworn by himself,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, and detest his fortresses. Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, inn khat a mi sawm a-omleh asi vek ding uhi.
english: It will happen that if ten men remain in one house, they will die.

paite: Huan vui ding a thaunilh, misite tanau, amaute halpa ngei in insung a kipan a aguh lakhe ding in, insung tawng pen a mi om kiang ah, "Na kiang ah kuahiam midang a-om lai uhia?" achih a, ama'n, "Om lou,” achihleh; ama'n, "Dai sipsip in! TOUPA min i lou ding uh ahi ngal kei a," achi ding hi.
english: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention Yahweh’s name.’

paite: Ngai dih ua, TOUPA'N thu apeta hi; inn lian achim lemlum ding a, inn neu leng akhangkham ik-iak ding hi.
english: “For, behold, Yahweh commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.

paite: Sakolte suangpi tung ah atai ding ua hia? Huai ah mi'n bawng in lei alet ding ua hia? Noute'n vaihawmna lah gu na suaksak ua diktatna gah singkha na suaksak uh.
english: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness,

paite: Nou thil bangmah lou tung a kipak a, i hatna in ahi kei maw kiite i lak ua? chite aw.
english: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’

paite: "En dih ua, Aw Israel inkote aw, nou hon dou ding in nam ka dingkhesak ding a; huan Hamath khomual a kipan in Arabah lui tan in nou ahon engbawl ding uh," TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian in achita hi.
english: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies; “and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.”
